tool.name: bedToBigBed
tool.command: #if $sizes.source == 'file' cut -f 1,2 '$sizes.chrom_sizes' > chrom.sizes && #end if if LC_ALL=C sort -c -k1,1 -k2,2n '$bed' 2> /dev/null; then sort_flag=''; else sort_flag='-sort'; fi && bedToBigBed -tab \$sort_flag #if $fields.mode == 'extra' #set $extra = int(str($bed.metadata.columns)) - int(str($fields.standard)) #if $extra > 0 -type=bed${fields.standard}+$extra #else -type=bed${fields.standard} #end if #if $fields.as_file -as='$fields.as_file' #end if #end if #if $sizes.source == 'twobit' -sizesIs2Bit '$bed' '$sizes.genome' #else '$bed' chrom.sizes #end if '$output'

param.name: bed
param.label: BED file
param.help: The input can be in any order. If it is not sorted, the tool sorts it.

param.name: genome
param.label: Genome 2bit file
param.help: Chromosome names must match the names in the BED file.

param.name: chrom_sizes
param.label: Chromosome sizes file
param.help: Chromosome name in column 1 and length in column 2, for example a len file or a FASTA index (fai) from samtools faidx. The tool ignores other columns. Chromosome names must match the names in the BED file.

param.name: mode
param.label: Extra fields
param.help: Extra fields are columns after the standard BED columns.
param.option: None, all columns are standard BED columns

param.name: standard
param.label: Number of standard BED columns
param.help: The tool counts the remaining columns as extra fields.

param.name: as_file
param.label: AutoSql (.as) file
param.help: Names and describes each column. Optional.

tool.help:
**What it does**
bedToBigBed converts a BED file to the [bigBed format](https://genome.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/help/bigBed.html). A bigBed file contains compressed data and an index. A genome browser can read one region of a bigBed file over the internet without reading the whole file. Use bigBed files for annotation tracks in a [track hub](https://genome.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/help/hgTrackHubHelp.html).
-----
**Input**
- **BED file**: the features to convert. Do not include `track` or `browser` lines. - **Chromosome sizes**: the length of each chromosome. Get them from the genome 2bit file, or from a chromosome sizes file (len or fai).
**Output**
A bigBed file.
-----
**Extra fields**
A [BED file](https://genome.ucsc.edu/FAQ/FAQformat.html#format1) has 3 to 12 standard columns. Columns after them are extra fields, for example the MAF block of a bigMaf file. If your file has extra fields, select the number of standard columns. The tool counts the extra fields and sets `-type=bedN+P`.
You can also give an [AutoSql](https://genome.ucsc.edu/docs/file-formats/autoSql.html) (.as) file. It gives the name, type and description of each column. Without it, each extra field gets a name from its column number, for example `field6`. Some track types need a specific AutoSql file, for example [bigMaf.as](https://genome.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/help/examples/bigMaf.as) for a bigMaf track.
-----
**More information**
- [bedToBigBed source code](https://github.com/ucscGenomeBrowser/kent/tree/master/src/utils/bedToBigBed)
